title: From a job to an asset
subtitle: The test: could it run a normal Tuesday without you?

steps.label: Job
steps.note: Trade hours for money. It stops when you stop.

steps.label: Practice
steps.note: Better paid, but still you, in a fancier trap

steps.label: Business
steps.note: Others do the work, and the process holds

steps.label: Asset
steps.note: It runs and grows, and someone would buy it

takeaway: If it stops when you stop, you own a job, not an asset.
